# Manuel Zavatta

> Manuel Zavatta is a software developer and content creator who builds software, designs systems, and shares his
experience through open-source projects, training, and technology videos.

## Background and experience

Manuel turned independent learning and consulting into a career in software development. He can build an MVP from
scratch and particularly enjoys designing lightweight, distributed and synchronized backend systems.

He began freelancing in April 2009, building websites and office automation applications and providing IT consulting,
training, and technical support. In 2010 he co-founded Gruppo MIPS, an IT and communications cooperative, where he
managed the IT division and administration. In July 2013 he joined the IT team of an international stainless steel
manufacturer, working on digitalization projects. In 2025 he reactivated his VAT registration for his content creation
work, brand collaborations, masterclasses, and occasional freelance projects alongside his full-time IT role.

## Content creation

Manuel launched his YouTube channel in March 2022 to share his experience and help aspiring developers. He covers
software development, system design, databases, servers, optimization, and technology from a developer's perspective.

## Open source

In 2019 Manuel created Wiki|Docs, an open-source wiki designed to be simple to install and use, with Markdown support.
He has been rewriting the project with a more structured approach and welcomes contributors.

## Services

- MVP development: build a working product focused on essential features to test an idea and collect feedback.
- Project and architecture consulting: analyze requirements, evaluate technologies, and design scalable, secure,
  maintainable software systems.
- Training and mentorship: personalized theoretical and practical learning paths.
- Brand and product collaborations: create content for products or services suited to his audience.
